verdict.rationale: OpenRouter itself mitigates provider rate limits by load balancing requests across top providers and by automatically falling back when a primary model's providers are rate-limited. Nothing documents spreading traffic across multiple keys or any request queuing or throttling, so only the rate-limit-smoothing core is covered. Missing for 10: multi-key traffic distribution, request queuing, client/server-side throttling controls, independent corroboration of rate-limit handling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can smooth provider rate limits by spreading traffic across keys and queuing or throttling requests

citations.quote: By default, requests are load balanced across the top providers to maximize uptime.
The models parameter lets you automatically try other models if the primary model's providers are down, rate-limited, or refuse to reply due to content moderation.
